uniteDbPokemon.notes: Unite-DB public pokemon.json. v3 enumerates skills, boosted basic attacks, nested upgrade choices, Plus/enhanced effects, Unite Moves, and Unite Buffs.

sourceList.originalDescription: When an opposing Pokémon decreases this Pokémon's movement speed, also decreases that opposing Pokémon's movement speed by 40% for 3s; or, when an opposing Pokémon inflicts a damage-over-time status condition on this Pokémon, also inflicts a damage-over time effect on that opposing Pokémon for 3s (8s CD). When an enemy inflicts decreased movement speed or a damge-over-time condition on the Pokémon, the same is inflicted on that opponent. This ability goes on cooldown after it's triggered.

Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack, damaging opposing Pokémon in the area of effect and decreasing their Sp. Def by 10% for 2s. Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack. When this boosted attack hits, it deals damage to enemies in the area of effect and decreases their Sp. Defense by 10% for a short time.
Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack. When this boosted attack hits, it deals damage to enemies in the area of effect and decreases their Sp. Defense by 10% for a short time.
The user fires a psychic bolt in the designated direction, damaging opposing Pokémon hit and decreasing their movement speed by 35% for 1s. Attacks straight in the designated direction.

The user launches a psychic bolt in the designated direction which blasts on the first opposing Pokémon hit or after traveling max distance, damaging opposing Pokémon in the area of effect. The blast creates a lingering field that slowly moves forward, dealing damage over time to opposing Pokémon in the area of effect and decreasing their movement speed by 60% for 1s (up to 5 hits). Each time this move hits opposing Pokémon, their Sp. Def is decreased by 27% for 4s (maximum 81%). After hitting an enemy or traveling its maximum distance, deals damage over time to enemies in the area of effect and decreases their movement speed and Sp. Defense by 20%, stacking up to 3 times.
Reduces this move's cooldown by 1s. Reduced cooldown.

The user dashes back slightly and launches a blast of moonlight in the designated direction which bursts into a cone behind the first opposing Pokémon hit, stunning that opposing Pokémon for 1.6s and damaging all opposing Pokémon in the cone area of effect, including the target. Has the user attack while moving back to create distance. When the move's blast hits, it deals damage to enemies in a cone and leaves the enemy closest to the user unable to act for a short time.
Grants the user a shield for 3s when launching the blast. Also grants a shield when this move is used.

The user readies a boosted attack and warps forward to the designated location. When this move is learned, passively increases the damage of Synchronize, auto attacks, and Confusion by 15% until this move is replaced. Has the user warp to the designated area, increasing the damage dealt by one basic attack after warping.

The user channels at a designated area relative to their position before launching three attacks in succession, damaging opposing Pokémon in the area of effect and reducing the user's moves' cooldowns by 15% with each attack that hits. The user is able to attack and move freely while channeling this move. Attacks the designated location three times. This move's cooldown is reduced each time one of these attacks hits an enemy.
Increases the damage of the next attack to hit each time an attack hits an opposing Pokémon. Increase the damage this move deals each time one of its attacks hits.

The user sets a delayed explosion at the designated area, damaging opposing Pokémon when the delayed explosion hits. If this move hits a Pokémon from the opposing team, the cooldown of this move is reduced by 75% and the user's movement speed is increased by 40% for 1.5s. Sets a delayed explosion. When the explosion hits an enemy, it reduces this move's cooldown.
Resets this move's cooldown when it hits a Pokémon from the opposing team. Reset this move's cooldown when the explosion hits an enemy.

The user warps space in the designated area, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon and pulling them toward the center 4 times. As the warped space disappears, it deals increased damage to opposing Pokémon in the area of effect and shoves them away from the center. Warps Space in the designated area, drawing in enemies to the center. Shoves and deals damage to enemies the instant the warped space disappears.
Buffs: 30% Movement Speed, 30% CDR, 20% Max HP Shield Buff duration: 6
